author: bfonta
body:
Extends the HLT MET validation, including MHT collections and generator-level MHT, plus MET-vs-MHT comparisons. Important restructure of  `METTester` + post-processing and harvesting, now also covering MHT. The plotting-script was also updated.                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                        
Tested with [QCD](https://bfontana.web.cern.ch/bfontana/MET_Valid/QCD/) and [Wprime](.) samples, for instance:

```bash
NEVENTS=1000                                                                                                                                                                            
GEOM="ExtendedRun4D128"                                                                                                                                                                 
ERA="Phase2C26I13M9"                                                                                                                                                                    
CONDS="auto:phase2_realistic_T35"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
VALIDSEQ="@hltValidation"                                                                                                                                                               
HLTSEQ="75e33" # NGTScouting                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                        
function mystep2() {                                                                                                                                                                    
    cmsDriver.py step2 -s L1P2GT,HLT:"${HLTSEQ}",DQM:trackingMonitorHLT,VALIDATION:"${VALIDSEQ}" \                                                                                      
                                 --conditions "${CONDS}" \                                                                                                                              
                                 --datatier GEN-SIM-DIGI-RAW,DQMIO \                                                                                                                    
                                 -n ${NEVENTS} \                                                                                                                                        
                                 --eventcontent FEVTDEBUGHLT,DQMIO \                                                                                                                    
                                 --geometry "${GEOM}" \                                                                                                                                 
                                 --era "${ERA}" \                                                                                                                                       
                                 --customise SLHCUpgradeSimulations/Configuration/aging.customise_aging_1000 \                                                                          
                                 --filein file:/eos/cms/store/relval/CMSSW_20_1_0_pre3/RelValWprimeToLNu_M2000_14TeV/GEN-SIM-DIGI-RAW/PU_150X_mcRun4_realistic_v1_STD_D128_RegeneratedGS_PU_20260903_192421_RV19-v1/2830000/... \                                                                                                        
                                 --fileout file:step2.root \                                                                                                                            
                                 --nThreads 24 \                                                                                                                                        
                                 --hltProcess HLTX \                                                                                                                                    
                                 --processName HLTX \                                                                                                                                   
                                 --inputCommands='keep *, drop *_hlt*_*_HLT, drop triggerTriggerFilterObjectWithRefs_l1t*_*_HLT'                                                        
}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                        
function mystep3() {                                                                                                                                                                    
    cmsDriver.py step3 -s HARVESTING:"${VALIDSEQ}" \                                                                                                                                    
                                 --conditions "${CONDS}" \                                                                                                                              
                                 --mc \                                                                                                                                                 
                                 --geometry "${GEOM}" \                                                                                                                                 
                                 --scenario pp \                                                                                                                                        
                                 --filetype DQM \                                                                                                                                       
                                 --era "${ERA}" \                                                                                                                                       
                                 -n ${NEVENTS} \                                                                                                                                        
                                 --hltProcess HLTX \                                                                                                                                    
                                 --filein file:step2_inDQM.root \                                                                                                                       
                                 --fileout file:step3.root                                                                                                                              
}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                        
mystep2 && mystep3
```

Based on [this presentation](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1698231/#sc-2-6-phase-2-central-validat).

Data samples used:
+ QCD: `/eos/cms/store/relval/CMSSW_20_1_0_pre3/RelValQCD_FlatPt_15_3000HS_14/GEN-SIM-DIGI-RAW/PU_150X_mcRun4_realistic_v1_STD_D128_RegeneratedGS_PU_20260903_192421_RV19-v1/2830000`
+ Wprime: `/eos/cms/store/relval/CMSSW_20_1_0_pre3/RelValWprimeToLNu_M2000_14TeV/GEN-SIM-DIGI-RAW/PU_150X_mcRun4_realistic_v1_STD_D128_RegeneratedGS_PU_20260903_192421_RV19-v1/2830000/`
title: Extend and restructure the MET and MHT validation
